see_for_yourself.expected: Cellist keeps the availability and shows as linked to Google; the second window lists the group and opens it as Cellist; as organizer you see Cellist's email.
steps: Create a group on your phone at rehearse.dalan.dev
In a private laptop window, join from the invite link as Cellist and add availability
In that window choose Sign in with Google
In a second private window, sign in with the same Google account from the start page
see_for_yourself.title: Link a name-only member and open the group elsewhere

what_just_landed.detail: Members can sign in with Google on the live site; a sign-in lasts 90 days after last use.
what_just_landed.title: Sign in with Google

what_just_landed.detail: Signing in from a group page links that member to the Google account without losing availability or answers.
what_just_landed.title: Name-only members keep their history

what_just_landed.detail: Signing in on another phone or laptop lists and opens every linked group.
what_just_landed.title: Your groups on every device

what_just_landed.detail: Organizers and the member see the linked Google email; everyone else sees only a Google mark.
what_just_landed.title: Private emails
